<script>
  class {
    GLOBAL = 'BuildStatus'

    init() {
      this.state.build = Fez.fetch('/api/build-status')
    }

    reload() {
      Fez.clearFetchCache()
      this.state.build = Fez.fetch('/api/build-status')
    }
  }
</script>

{#await state.build}
  <p>Checking build...</p>
{:then build}
  <p>Build {build.id}: {build.status}</p>
{:catch error}
  <p>Could not load status: {error.message}</p>
{/await}

<button onclick="fez.reload()">Reload</button>
